scope: Actual-host/manual integration scenarios; all unrun in source delivery. Separate from 38 supplied native automation tests.

tests.name: Opt-in disabled
tests.procedure: Run real Windows host with bEnableDisplaySettings=false. Open Display settings.
tests.expected: No display request or preference write; explanatory unavailable screen; other menus work.

tests.name: PIE refusal
tests.procedure: Opt in and open Display settings in embedded PIE and editor standalone viewport.
tests.expected: No window change; clear unavailable diagnostic. These are not accepted Windows tests.

tests.name: Eligible host catalogue
tests.procedure: Launch real Windows game with one local controller, standard settings object and opt-in.
tests.expected: Record actual native class/viewport, supported and convenient mode lists. No hardcoded monitor list.

tests.name: Draft isolation
tests.procedure: Change mode and resolution repeatedly without Test.
tests.expected: Current viewport, engine saved settings, campaign and local preference slots stay unchanged.

tests.name: Discard draft
tests.procedure: Change draft then Back and reopen.
tests.expected: Draft resets to actual viewport. No display request/save occurred.

tests.name: Windowed trial keep
tests.procedure: Choose a reported different windowed size, Test, wait for new-mode paint, Keep session-only.
tests.expected: Only deliberate later-frame Keep succeeds; actual size matches; no engine or Coastal preference save requested.

tests.name: Exclusive fullscreen
tests.procedure: If advertised supported, test a listed exclusive resolution.
tests.expected: Actual mode/size must match before Keep. A normalized/rejected mode never masquerades as success.

tests.name: Borderless desktop
tests.procedure: Test engine-reported desktop borderless candidate on the intended monitor.
tests.expected: Actual size/mode matches or trial reverts. Do not mark multi-monitor support passed merely from one viewport size.

tests.name: Resolution bounds
tests.procedure: Inspect native enumerated candidates with small, duplicate, unusual or huge results.
tests.expected: Only unique admitted modes appear. No fabricated 1080p entry or out-of-range manual input.

tests.name: Default Revert focus
tests.procedure: Test a new mode with controller only.
tests.expected: Revert is initial/default focus, never Keep. Held confirm cannot accept the trial.

tests.name: No opening-frame keep
tests.procedure: Use deliberate automated native input to attempt Keep on opening/matching frame.
tests.expected: No keep/save. Existing top-ticket/frame rules and new matched-frame gate remain effective.

tests.name: Repaint in new mode
tests.procedure: Delay native resolution request application while old-mode dialog paints.
tests.expected: Old paint cannot enable Keep. Reset/scroll to new-mode body, later paint and later input are needed.

tests.name: Unpainted cancellation
tests.procedure: Press Escape/B after opening but before mode-matched body paint.
tests.expected: A fresh later-frame cancel may revert without waiting for paint; no mission/UI ownership bypass.

tests.name: Paused deadline
tests.procedure: Leave confirmation idle while the native UI pauses the world.
tests.expected: At first running observation at/after 15 real seconds, one restore request, no save; countdown visible.

tests.name: Hitch across deadline
tests.procedure: Introduce controlled game-thread delay spanning deadline.
tests.expected: On resume no Keep before rollback; no claim that frozen code restored during the stall.

tests.name: Exact deadline input
tests.procedure: Attempt Keep at and after deadline before next regular UI tick.
tests.expected: Command-path realtime recheck rejects and requests restoration.

tests.name: Manual Revert
tests.procedure: Test mode and activate Revert.
tests.expected: One restore request; panel closes; further trials blocked until later-frame original viewport observed.

tests.name: Back cancellation
tests.procedure: Test then Escape/B, repeat Back and close parent.
tests.expected: No duplicate restore; parent focus works; pending restoration continues while parent closed.

tests.name: Observed focus loss
tests.procedure: Alt-Tab/minimize while testing; return to game.
tests.expected: First observed foreground loss cancels trial. No hidden/background Keep/save.

tests.name: Suppressed native switch
tests.procedure: Make mode request ineffective using a controlled local setup.
tests.expected: Keep never enables; timeout requests original. No fake applied/saved result.

tests.name: Rollback failure
tests.procedure: Use a disposable host fault to prevent requested original mode from appearing.
tests.expected: After 5 seconds of running observation, diagnostic and trial lock; no infinite retry or claimed success.

tests.name: Same-frame restore
tests.procedure: Instrument immediate read after restore request before resolution sinks run.
tests.expected: Same-frame preexisting size does not count as observed restoration.

tests.name: Successive session-only trials
tests.procedure: Keep mode B session-only from A; test C and revert.
tests.expected: Return to B, not older engine saved A; no unrelated preference migration.

tests.name: Explicit engine save
tests.procedure: Test and explicitly Keep plus save request; close/relaunch actual Windows game.
tests.expected: Record engine file/logs and actual relaunched mode; UI says save requested, not verified save. Separate from campaign acknowledgement.

tests.name: Engine save failure
tests.procedure: Use disposable backed-up engine settings with a real controlled write failure.
tests.expected: No claimed disk verification; session mode remains kept; relaunch behavior and logs recorded, not assumed.

tests.name: No writes on crash-before-keep
tests.procedure: Back up engine settings then close/kill disposable game during trial and relaunch.
tests.expected: Trial source made no explicit save; examine actual engine host/autosave behavior. No hard crash-safety guarantee.

tests.name: Competing settings field writer
tests.procedure: During trial change engine settings size/mode through a separate controlled owner.
tests.expected: Trial cancels, foreign stored values not overwritten, source locks after rollback observation. Remove competing owner before production.

tests.name: Unobserved/same-value writer limitation
tests.procedure: Audit actual host for Alt-Enter, console, graphics menus and same-valued writers.
tests.expected: One intentional owner retained; acknowledge source cannot detect every temporary/same-value/global config writer.

tests.name: Lost fixed viewport
tests.procedure: Replace/remove viewport client or controller in disposable native test.
tests.expected: No request against a replacement viewport; failure diagnostic, no automatic rebind or saved trial.

tests.name: Shutdown ordering
tests.procedure: Exit/remove UI during active/reverting trial and repeat supported release.
tests.expected: At most one new restore request for active trial, no extra save, no false restoration claim after ticking stops.

tests.name: Session epoch replacement
tests.procedure: Trigger legitimate New/Continue while trial is active using a controlled native integration test.
tests.expected: Old trial canceled, no stale Keep changes new epoch; save callback does not reenter campaign mutation.

tests.name: Recovery/safe return
tests.procedure: Activate retained recovery/return while testing display.
tests.expected: Cancel display without consuming items, moving checkpoints, clearing recovery, or acknowledging transcript.

tests.name: 720p readability
tests.procedure: Test all new screens at 1280x720, 100% and 150% text.
tests.expected: Mode description, timer, Revert and Keep usable via scroll; reset paint not stranded offscreen; controller focus remains visible.

tests.name: 1080p controller path
tests.procedure: Test every display command at 1920x1080 via controller-only and keyboard/mouse.
tests.expected: One command per frame; correct focus/Back; no gameplay input beneath menus or accidental Keep on held buttons.

tests.name: Multiple-monitor limitation
tests.procedure: Test actual mixed-DPI/secondary monitor arrangements and device removal.
tests.expected: Record actual behavior; mismatched requested size cannot be kept. Monitor/position/HDR/refresh restoration is outside scope.

tests.name: Custom settings/XR refusal
tests.procedure: Use a custom UGameUserSettings subclass or active XR-system host.
tests.expected: Unavailable rather than guessing subclass side effects or resizing a VR presentation.

tests.name: Previous campaign and options
tests.procedure: Load existing schema-3 player options and a backed-up campaign, use display menu, complete radio.
tests.expected: Campaign/story/item/receipt behavior unchanged; no new Coastal preference schema or slot; audio/transcript remain independent.

tests.name: Full Windows gate
tests.procedure: Package and launch real host; complete New, collect, storage round-trip, repair, transcript, safe return, verified save, relaunch, Continue.
tests.expected: Actual coherent gameplay with AGIS/Hyper and independent options. Only this full retained acceptance gate advances M1.
